background.prompt: A violent storm at sea: towering dark grey-blue waves with white crests filling the lower two thirds, black rolling storm clouds above, a pale flash of lightning in the far distance, sheets of rain, no land. Completely EMPTY: no boat, no ship, no people. Keep the centre of the water clear.

ship-storm.prompt: The same ancient wooden sailing ship with a single mast, its cream square sail torn and flapping loose, tilted steeply as if pitching on a wave, oars askew, seen from the side, in the same soft cutout illustration style as the reference image.
